prompt: Check local-agent progress for the active autonomous goal in this conversation. Use the latest GitHub status and result evidence. If local-agent is still running a task, do not queue another task. If the previous task finished and local-agent is idle, analyze its result and continue with the next necessary task. If the autonomous goal is complete, end your response with [LOCAL_AGENT_BRIDGE:STOP]. If progress requires the user to perform a manual action before automation can continue, end your response with [LOCAL_AGENT_BRIDGE:PAUSE]. Otherwise do not emit a bridge control marker.
